def main():
    s = input().strip()
    runs = []
    cnt = 1
    for i in range(1, len(s)):
        if s[i] == s[i-1]:
            cnt += 1
        else:
            runs.append(cnt)
            cnt = 1
    runs.append(cnt)
    ans = sum(1 for length in runs if length % 2 == 0)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
